# rust.build and rust.exe in a workspace: `package` selects a member, whose
# inputs are its own files and those of its local dependencies, and rust.exe
# infers a package's only binary.
[!exec:cargo] skip

bit
stdout 'all ▶ cargo build$'
stdout 'lib ▶ cargo build -p lib$'
stdout 'app ▶ cargo build -p app --message-format json$'
stdout 'tool ▶ cargo build -p other --message-format json$'
exec target/debug/app
stdout '\Aapp uses lib 1\n\z'
exec target/debug/tool
stdout '\Atool\n\z'

bit
! stdout '✔ ok'

# A file outside every package is no input.
cp notes.txt.changed notes.txt
bit
! stdout '✔ ok'

# A change in one member leaves the others alone. The runner's cp keeps the
# file's older mtime on macOS, which cargo reads as unchanged, so the system
# cp writes the changes.
exec cp tool.rs.changed other/src/main.rs
bit
stdout 'tool ▶ .*other/src/main\.rs'
stdout 'all ✔ ok'
stdout 'lib · no changes'
stdout 'app · no changes'
exec target/debug/tool
stdout '\Atool 2\n\z'

# A change in a dependency rebuilds what uses it.
exec cp lib.rs.changed lib/src/lib.rs
bit
stdout 'lib ✔ ok'
stdout 'app ▶ .*lib/src/lib\.rs'
stdout 'all ✔ ok'
stdout 'tool · no changes'
exec target/debug/app
stdout '\Aapp uses lib 2\n\z'

# An unknown package is an error.
cp BUILD.bit.missing BUILD.bit
! bit
stderr 'Rust package ''missing'' not found in workspace'

-- BUILD.bit --
all = rust.build {}

lib = rust.build {
  package = "lib"
}

app = rust.exe {
  package = "app"
}

tool = rust.exe {
  package = "other"
}
-- BUILD.bit.missing --
missing = rust.build {
  package = "missing"
}
-- notes.txt --
notes
-- notes.txt.changed --
more notes
-- Cargo.toml --
[workspace]
members = ["app", "lib", "other"]
resolver = "2"
-- app/Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "app"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
lib = { path = "../lib" }
-- app/src/main.rs --
fn main() {
    println!("app uses lib {}", lib::VERSION);
}
-- lib/Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "lib"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
-- lib/src/lib.rs --
pub const VERSION: u32 = 1;
-- lib.rs.changed --
pub const VERSION: u32 = 2;
-- other/Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "other"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[[bin]]
name = "tool"
path = "src/main.rs"
-- other/src/main.rs --
fn main() {
    println!("tool");
}
-- tool.rs.changed --
fn main() {
    println!("tool 2");
}
